full_judgment: 3. The predecessors of the present respondent Nos. 1-19 as defendant Nos. 1-4 contested the suit by filing a joint written statement. These defendants denied the material case of the plaintiffs and stated, inter-alia, that the suit is not maintainable as it is barred by principle of res-judicata. The positive case of the defendant Nos.1- 4, in short, is that the suit property which is known as "Burrer Pukur" was recorded in Moghi Chita Survey as Plot No.699 under Taraf Syed Md. Arshad. That Azmatullah and Mujibullah became the tenants under Taraf through settlement. That for arrear rent the suit property was put into auction and Ijjat Ali, Mosharrof Ali and Anwar Ali purchased the same in auction and got possession thereof. That the said auction purchasers subsequently settled this property to Ali Mahmud on 25th falgun, 1257 B.S. Ali Mahmud possessed the suit tank by rearing and preserving fish and the bank by planting and collecting usufructs thereof. Thereafter Ali Mahmud died leaving behind two sons namely Abdul Ali and Nazir Ali. On 22.07.1280 B.S. Nazir Ali transferred his share in favour of Abdul Ali by registered kabala and in the said kabala Ali Hossain the predecessors of the plaintiffs was an attesting witness. That Abdul Ali became sole owner of the suit tank and constructed house on the bank of the tank. That the landlord collected rent from Abdul Ali and others through Rent Suit Nos.765 of 1914 and 1397 of 1918. That meanwhile the suit tank was recorded in plot Nos.611 and 612 in the names of Abdul Aziz and Abdul Fattah in the cadastral survey. That such record was wrong and baseless. That the Government acquired no right or title in the suit land and it was never taken as khas land of the Government. That the tank was never included in Nayabad Mahal. That Abdul Aziz and Abdul Fattah never possessed the suit tank. That preparation of the R.S. record of rights following the C.S. record of right in the names of Abdul Aziz and others was equally wrong and never acted upon. That the predecessors of the plaintiffs and proforma defendant Nos. 32 62 created and fabricated the so called unregistered patta dated 10.05.1913. "That the said so called patta is seen to be written after 21/22 years of purchase of the stamps. That the predecessor of the plaintiffs claimed the suit land as their purchased land in Other Suit No.17 of 1957, but failed to produce any kabala and never pointed out the existence of patio dated 10.05.1913. That at the time of R.S. operation the predecessor of the defendant Nos. 1-4 Abdul Ali went to Rengun for earning money and he entrusted his brother-in-law Ali .Hossain-the predecessors of the plaintiffs to get the tank recorded in his name, but Ali Hossain got the tank fraudulently recorded in the names of Syed Abdul Aziz and others with a note of permissive possession of Ali Hossain. That after returning from Rengoon Abdul Ali died leaving behind defendant No.1 and Jobbar Ali as two sons and two daughters. That the defendant No.1 and his brother Jobbar Ali and sister Amena Khaton instituted Other Suit No. 17 of 1957 and obtained a decree declaring their title in the suit tank. That thereafter defendant Nos. 1-14 and 15 of the said suit filed two different appeals being Nos. 498 of 1958 and 27 of 1959 before the District Ridge which were dismissed on contest and thereafter Second appeal being No. 505 of 1963 was filed before the High Court Division which also was dismissed. That the plaintiffs never had any title or possession in the suit tank and as such the suit filed by them is liable to be dismissed.
